_manual_note: Items with no bill/PDF in the folder. 'recurring_monthly' expands to one line per month (dated the 1st). 'source' = file in the bills folder shown as that line's exhibit (never re-parsed as a bill).
_line_sources_note: Attach a real document to a line that was built without one (mortgage notices, email-sourced bills). Each: {vendor substring, date, amount, file}. Files live under <bills folder>/_sources/ and are never re-parsed as bills.
_dispute_api_note: Base URL of the deployed Vercel dispute API (e.g. https://pearson-dispute-api.vercel.app). When set, the portal's Dispute button emails Ned one-click Approve/Deny buttons; Approve auto-removes the charge. Leave blank to fall back to plain FormSubmit email. See dispute-api/SETUP.md.
_exclude_business_note: Vendors/terms that are BUSINESS, never household. Any bill whose vendor/description/file matches one of these is auto-excluded from the reimbursement claim.
_exclude_charges_note: Specific individual charges removed from the claim by Ned (matched on vendor substring + date + amount).
